thread:
sam: Heads-up: planning a compact base rebuild + key rotation next Wed 07:00 PT. Goals: remove legacy gzip libraries, rotate cosign key in KMS, and make sure every promoted image has an audit event linking image SHA -> SBOM -> signature -> keyVersion. Need RBAC + telemetry sanity checks before we start the canary.

nat: Proposal: tiny canary first (2% of nodes) for 20m, then 20% for 25m, then full. We'll run automated SBOM+sig verification between waves.

priya: On RBAC: signer SA only has Decrypt today. We'll need Sign for the cosign signer principal, plus publicKeyViewer for the ops/verifier SA in other projects. Also ensure the attestor emits auditlog:write.

sam: Can you paste the minimal IAM snippet you want? I'll include it in the infra MR.

priya: Minimal (GCP-style):
```
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> serviceAccount:runtime-cosign-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer -> serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Grant publicKeyViewer only for 48h post-rotation.

security-bot: CI: allowlist drift detected for `zlib` on candidate image (warning, not blocking). See https://ci.internal/scan/32555.

nat: We'll triage zlib. If it's a minor semver bump with no CVE, mark non-blocker after SBOM diff review. Priya, can you own vuln triage?

priya: On it. ETA 90m. Will upload SBOM diff and note whether any found CVEs are recent/high.

sam: Ops asked for a minimal audit event example for telemetry to accept the new fields (keyVersion + keyFingerprint). Draft: 
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:7a8b9c0d...",
  "sbom_uri": "gs://sboms/sha256-7a8b9c.json",
  "signature_ref": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cosign/signatures/abcd",
  "key_version": "12",
  "key_fingerprint": "SHA256:0A1B2C3D...",
  "promoted_by": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "timestamp": "2026-08-11T14:00:00Z"
}
```

infra-bot: Reminder: CI will assert that post-signing job writes signature metadata to the audit topic and that `auditlog:write` is emitted.

pager: Rollback playbook (triggers: verification mismatch or canary error rate >3%):
```
# revert registry tag to previous digest
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous digest explicitly
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha -n runtime || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime
# reattach previous attestation if needed
cosign attach --predicate old-predicate.json --signature old.sig gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha
```

sam: Good. Also add a post-promotion cache invalidation so KV/prefix caches that reference image metadata don't hold stale SBOM links. I'll add a pipeline step.

priya: Triage update: zlib bump is a patch-level bump; no NVD CVEs and internal DB clean. Marking non-blocker; SBOM diff uploaded to the MR.

nat: Action items: 1) @priya attach SBOM diff & triage note to MR, 2) @sam open infra MR with kms:Sign + publicKeyViewer and condition to expire Viewer after 48h, 3) @infra-bot ensure CI checks auditlog emission, 4) @pager add rollback snippet to runbook and be on watch. Canary Wed 07:00 PT.

priya: MR opened: https://git.internal/infra/mr/81234 (includes terraform snippet, acceptance tests, and plan to expire Viewer binding after 48h). Please review.

security-bot: Note: add `key_version` to telemetry's dedup key so we can map signatures to KMS versions in forensics.

sam: We'll include key_version and key_fingerprint fields in the audit event. Ops will accept the small schema bump.

nat: If CI passes and we get two approvals, we merge and proceed. If any verification job fails during canary we'll trigger the rollback and open an incident.

priya: Vulnerability triage done; non-blocker. Approving the plan from a vuln perspective.

pager: I'll be watching the window and will page SRE on signature.verify.fail alerts.

sam: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the runbook link once MR merges and the pipeline is updated.

nat: Thanks — lgtm from me.
